description: This file defines the CartProvider class for managing the shopping cart state in a Flutter application, including methods for adding, removing, and updating cart items, as well as calculating totals.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages cart items and related calculations for a food delivery app.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a menu item to the cart, updating quantity if the item already exists, and clears the cart if the restaurant changes.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart by its menu item ID.

methods.name: changeQty
methods.description: Changes the quantity of a specified menu item in the cart, removing it if the quantity is zero or less.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart and resets restaurant ID.
